newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RMP, Barprop caution shareholders.
newsitem.headline: RMP, Barprop caution shareholders.

text.p: RMP Properties Ltd and Barprop Ltd said on Monday that the proposed rationalisation of the two companies was proceeding and an application for approval from the authorities would be made in the next two weeks.
The companies announced on March 25 that they had proposed rationalising their listings and capital structures.
The companies also said on Monday that Randgold & Exploration Co Ltd's had begun a due diligence exercise with regard to its potential purchase of RMP's land clearing and gold recovery operations.

Ordinary shareholders in RMP and Barprop and loan stock unit holders in Barprop were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings until a further announcement was made on or before June 30 1997.
